ImageDescription.value:
Anna Koval talks about the Wikipedia Education Program pilot at the Second Chance Schools in Corfu and congratulates the Class of 2015 for their contribution to the Wikimedia movement.

Captions by Andrew Sherman (WMF).

Translation by Marios Magioladitis.

And a couple of helpful content tips from Kacie Harold (WMF) and Sati Houston (WMF).

More information about this Wikipedia Education Program pilot is available at: Outreach:Education/Countries/Greece.
